item.title: Rallying Cry – August 10, 2026
item.description: Singapore's National Day Parade celebrated record civilian participation with people with disabilities taking center stage, Demi Vollering made history by winning the Tour de France Femmes, and a creative use of human hair is now protecting our oceans.
